title: Provider subagent tool vocabularies drift silently — probe the runtime registry before projecting
summary: Generated provider agent definitions must be re-verified against the target CLI version: agy 1.5.x dropped 8 tool names that 1.4.x accepted (view_code_item etc.), failing at startup with unknown-component errors. Verify by invoking a single-tool probe agent per name; keep provider tool lists as a validated allowlist at the adapter boundary, and keep .agents/agents/ exclusively owned by the AGY projection since it is agy only custom-agent path.
hint_triggers: Pilot #1 showed a generated subagent failing at startup because the adapter emitted a tool name the new agy registry no longer contains. Fixes that proved durable: (1) treat AGY_KNOWN_TOOLS as a runtime-verified allowlist and re-probe on version bumps (single-tool probe agent + short --print-timeout distinguishes resolve errors from model calls); (2) fresh worktrees need one bootstrap command (pnpm prepare:worktree = install + build:packages + build:repo) because verification commands run compiled output; (3) cross-worktree evidence writes belong behind --mission-root, validated as a same-repo worktree and confined to <root>/active/missions/** via the governed child-process writer (writePromotedFilesToWorktree), never by widening path validation.
